arxiv-2012-02826.title: Numerical solution of a time-fractional nonlinear Rayleigh-Stokes problem
arxiv-2012-02826.creator: Mariam Al-Maskari, and, Samir Karaa
arxiv-2012-02826.description: Abstract We study a semilinear fractional-in-time Rayleigh-Stokes problem for a generalized second-grade fluid with a Lipschitz continuous nonlinear source term and initial data u 0 ∈ H ˙ ν ​ ( Ω ) u_{0}\in\dot{H}^{\nu}(\Omega) , ν ∈ [ 0 , 2 ] \nu\in[0,2] . We discuss stability of solutions and provide regularity results.

arxiv-2105-01295.title: Testing the microstructure of d d -dimensional charged Gauss-Bonnet anti-de Sitter black holes
arxiv-2105-01295.creator: Shao-Wen Wei , Yu-Xiao Liu
arxiv-2105-01295.description: Abstract Understanding black hole microstructure via the thermodynamic geometry can provide us with more deeper insight into black hole thermodynamics in modified gravities. In this paper, we study the black hole phase transition and Ruppeiner geometry for the d d -dimensional charged Gauss-Bonnet anti-de Sitter black holes.

arxiv-2112-13285.title: Pedagogical Rule Extraction to Learn Interpretable Models — an Empirical Study
arxiv-2112-13285.creator: Vadim Arzamasov, Benjamin Jochum, Klemens Böhm
arxiv-2112-13285.description: Abstract Machine-learning models are ubiquitous. In some domains, for instance, in medicine, the models’ predictions must be interpretable. Decision trees, classification rules, and subgroup discovery are three broad categories of supervised machine-learning models presenting knowledge in the form of interpretable rules. The accuracy of these models learned from small datasets is usually low.

arxiv-2204-00940.title: Comparison of Non-Archimedean and Logarithmic Mirror Constructions via the Frobenius Structure Theorem
arxiv-2204-00940.creator: Samuel Johnston
arxiv-2204-00940.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Samuel Johnston. For a log Calabi Yau pair ( X , D X,D ) with X ∖ D X\setminus D smooth affine, satisfying either a maximal degeneracy assumption or contains a Zariski dense torus, we prove under the condition that D is the support of a nef divisor that the structure constants defining a trace form on the mirror algebra constructed by Gross-Siebert are given by the naive curve counts defined by Keel-Yu.

arxiv-2212-02132.title: Proximity effect in PbTe-Pb hybrid nanowire Josephson junctions
arxiv-2212-02132.creator: Zitong Zhang, Wenyu Song, Yichun Gao, Yuhao Wang, Zehao Yu, Shuai Yang, Yuying Jiang, Wentao Miao, Ruidong Li, Fangting Chen, Zuhan Geng, Qinghua Zhang, Fanqi Meng, Ting Lin, Lin Gu, Kejing Zhu, Yunyi Zang, Lin Li, Runan Shang, Xiao Feng, Qi-Kun Xue, Ke He, Hao Zhang
arxiv-2212-02132.description: Abstract Semiconductor-superconductor hybrid nanowires are a leading material platform for the realization of Majorana zero modes. The semiconductors in previous studies are dominantly InAs or InSb. In this work, we show the induced superconductivity in a PbTe nanowire epitaxially coupled to a superconductor Pb.

arxiv-2305-08030.title: The two Higgs doublet type-II seesaw model: Naturalness and B ¯ → X s ​ γ \bar{B}\to X_{s}\gamma versus heavy Higgs masses
arxiv-2305-08030.creator: B. Ait Ouazghour 1, M. Chabab 1
arxiv-2305-08030.description: Abstract We extend the work Ouazghour:2018mld to a more general and detailed analysis through studying the naturalness problem and B B physics constraints within the context of two higgs doublets model augmented with a complex scalar triplet field ( 2 ​ H ​ D ​ M ​ c ​ T 2HDMcT ).

arxiv-2406-18888.title: On estimation of the convergence rate to invariant measures in Markov Branching Processes with possibly infinite variance and allowing immigration Thanks: © 2023 Imomov A.A
arxiv-2406-18888.creator: Azam A. IMOMOV
arxiv-2406-18888.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Azam A. IMOMOV. The paper discusses the continuous-time Markov Branching Process allowing Immigration. We are considering a critical case for which the second moment of offspring law and the first moment of immigration law are possibly infinite. Assuming that the nonlinear parts of the appropriate generating functions are regularly varying in the sense of Karamata, we prove theorems on convergence of transition functions of the process to invariant measures.

arxiv-2505-13043.title: A Generalized Label Shift Perspective for Cross-Domain Gaze Estimation
arxiv-2505-13043.creator: Hao-Ran Yang, Xiaohui Chen *, Chuan-Xian Ren
arxiv-2505-13043.description: Abstract Aiming to generalize the well-trained gaze estimation model to new target domains, Cross-domain Gaze Estimation (CDGE) is developed for real-world application scenarios. Existing CDGE methods typically extract the domain-invariant features to mitigate domain shift in feature space, which is proved insufficient by Generalized Label Shift (GLS) theory.

arxiv-2507-22108.title: Boosting VBF Reconstruction at Muon Colliders
arxiv-2507-22108.creator: Carlos Henrique de Lima
arxiv-2507-22108.description: Abstract Forward muon detection at high-energy muon colliders is crucial for resolving the underlying electroweak process. This work proposes a novel strategy using asymmetric beam energies to boost one of the forward muons into the detector acceptance, enhancing the ability to distinguish between W W - and Z Z -initiated vector boson fusion processes.

arxiv-2509-08461.title: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Neutrino Event Classification in High-Energy Physics
arxiv-2509-08461.creator: Dikshant Sagar ∗, Kaiwen Yu ∗, Alejandro Yankelevich, Jianming Bian, Pierre Baldi
arxiv-2509-08461.description: Abstract Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) [ 1 ] have demonstrated their remarkable capacity to process and reason over structured and unstructured data modalities beyond natural language [ 2 ] . In this work, we explore the applications of Vision Language Models (VLMs), specifically a fine-tuned variant of LLaMa 3.

arxiv-2602-03507.title: FaithRL: Learning to Reason Faithfully through Step-Level Faithfulness Maximization
arxiv-2602-03507.creator: Runquan Gui, Yafu Li, Xiaoye Qu, Ziyan Liu, Yeqiu Cheng, Yu Cheng
arxiv-2602-03507.description: Abstract Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has markedly improved the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on tasks requiring multi-step reasoning. However, most RLVR pipelines rely on sparse outcome-based rewards, providing little supervision over intermediate steps and thus encouraging over-confidence and spurious reasoning, which in turn increases hallucinations.

pmc-10647008.title: T1−/T2‐weighted ratio reveals no alterations to gray matter myelination in temporal lobe epilepsy
pmc-10647008.creator: Colin Denis, Kevin Dabbs, Veena A Nair, Jedidiah Mathis, Dace N Almane, Akshayaa Lakshmanan, Andrew Nencka, Rasmus M Birn, Lisa Conant, Colin Humphries, Elizabeth Felton, Manoj Raghavan, Edgar A DeYoe, Jeffrey R Binder, Bruce Hermann, Vivek Prabhakaran, Barbara B Bendlin, Mary E Meyerand, Mélanie Bo
pmc-10647008.description: Short‐range functional connectivity in the limbic network is increased in patients with temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE), and recent studies have shown that cortical myelin content correlates with fMRI connectivity. We thus hypothesized that myelin may increase progressively in the epileptic network.

pmc-11325330.title: Single-cell RNA Sequencing Identifies Natural Kill Cell-Related Transcription Factors Associated With Age-Related Macular Degeneration
pmc-11325330.creator: Yili Luo, Jianpeng Liu, Wangqiang Feng, Da Lin, Mengji Chen, Haihua Zheng
pmc-11325330.description: Background:Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) poses a growing global health concern as the leading cause of central vision loss in elderly people.Objection:This study focuses on unraveling the intricate involvement of Natural Killer (NK) cells in AMD, shedding light on their immune responses and cytokine regulatory roles.Methods:Transcriptomic data from the Gene Expression Omnibus database were utilized, employing single-cell RNA-seq analysis.

pmc-11355045.title: Agrimonia coreana Extract Exerts Its Therapeutic Effect through CRAC Channel Inhibition for Atopic Dermatitis Treatment
pmc-11355045.creator: Jintae Kim, Ji Min Lee, Su Jin Park, Yu Ran Nam, Seong Woo Choi, Joo Hyun Nam, Hyun Jong Kim, Woo Kyung Kim, Naoko Kanda
pmc-11355045.description: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a common allergic inflammatory skin condition marked by severe itching, skin lichenification, and chronic inflammation. AD results from a complex immune response, primarily driven by T lymphocytes and environmental triggers, leading to a disrupted epidermal barrier function. Traditional treatments, such as topical corticosteroids, have limitations due to long-term side effects, highlighting the need for safer alternatives.

pmc-12756029.title: Ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy shows promising efficacy in an ALK fusion-positive lung adenocarcinoma patient with ALK-TKI resistance: a case report
pmc-12756029.creator: Meiyuan Lin, Yuan Gao, Jun Deng
pmc-12756029.description: This report describes a case of lung adenocarcinoma harboring an echinoderm microtubule-associated protein-like 4–anaplastic lymphoma kinase (EML4–ALK) fusion, high programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression, and a Bcl-2-like protein 11 (BIM) deletion polymorphism. The patient was initially treated with alectinib, but experienced rapid disease progression. After repeat genetic testing, therapy was switched to lorlatinib, which again resulted in early progression.
